lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice choosing between preterite and present perfect in simple everyday talk.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Colleagues discuss a recent café visit and whether they have tried a place before.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Distinguishing a completed past event from a general or recent experience.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about a new café: one visit happened yesterday, and one experience is described more generally.

main_focus.name: preterite versus present perfect
main_focus.description: Use preterite for a specific completed time and present perfect for experience or present relevance.
model_examples: Jag har varit där två gånger.
Vi åt lunch där i fredags.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 2-3 preterite examples and 2-3 present-perfect examples naturally.

avoid_grammar: detailed tense theory inside the dialogue

vocabulary_target.theme: café visits and trying something new
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use time expressions to make the tense choice clear.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker mentions a café visit from a specific past day.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss whether the place or food has been tried before.
dialogue_shape.ending: They end with a possible plan to go again.

target_complexity.repetition: contrast specific past time with experience, but keep it conversational

focus: the experience or recent relevance being discussed
the possible future plan connected to the café

sentence_focus: one sentence with igår and preterite
one question with Har du varit
one sentence about food at a café
one sentence suggesting a future visit
